displayName: Web Server Process Spawning Command Shell (Web Shell Follow-On)

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe", "httpd", "apache2", "nginx", "tomcat9.exe", "java.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "sh", "bash", "whoami.exe", "whoami", "certutil.exe", "curl", "wget")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Web Server Process Spawning Command Shell (Web Shell Follow-On)
alertTemplate.description: Detects web server or application gateway worker processes spawning command shells or reconnaissance binaries, indicative of web shell execution following exploitation of internet-facing applications or appliances. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405. Advisories: acsc-2026-10-01-citrix-netscaler-critical-vulnerabilities, acsc-2026-11-17-vulnerabilities-patch-protect-prevent.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Inspect web server logs and webroot files for webshells, verify patch status of the internet-facing application, and contain the host (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1144, ISM-1405; Advisories: acsc-2026-10-01-citrix-netscaler-critical-vulnerabilities, acsc-2026-11-17-vulnerabilities-patch-protect-prevent).
